function.name: is_writer_handler
function.description: This function checks if the object type of the handler is either BLOCK_WRITER or WRITER.

parameters.name: handler
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the query handler structure.

function.return_type: bool, returns true if the object type of the handler is either BLOCK_WRITER or WRITER, otherwise false.

function.name: is_block_handler
function.description: This function checks if the object type of the handler is either BLOCK_READER or BLOCK_WRITER.

parameters.name: handler
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the query handler structure.

function.return_type: bool, returns true if the object type of the handler is either BLOCK_READER or BLOCK_WRITER, otherwise false.

function.name: impl_from_IWICMetadataQueryWriter
function.description: This function returns a pointer to a query_handler structure that contains the given IWICMetadataQueryWriter interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICMetadataQueryWriter interface

function.return_type: struct query_handler pointer, represents a pointer to the query_handler structure that contains the given IWICMetadataQueryWriter interface

function.name: query_handler_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface ID matches with any of the known interface IDs. If it does, it assigns the corresponding interface to the output parameter and increases its reference count. If it doesn't, it assigns NULL to the output parameter.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICMetadataQueryWriter interface

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being requested

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer that, if the function is successful, points to the requested interface

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call. S_OK if the function was successful, E_NOINTERFACE if the requested interface is not supported

function.name: query_handler_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the query handler object and returns the updated count.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to the interface of the metadata query writer.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the updated reference count of the query handler object.

function.name: query_handler_Release
function.description: This function decrements the reference count of the given query handler. If the reference count becomes zero, it releases the associated handler object and frees the memory allocated for the root and the handler itself.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: A pointer to an interface for a metadata query writer.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after decrement.

function.name: query_handler_GetContainerFormat
function.description: This function retrieves the container format of the metadata query writer or the metadata reader.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an instance of the IWICMetadataQueryWriter interface.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Pointer to a GUID variable that receives the container format.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: query_handler_GetLocation
function.description: This function retrieves the location of a metadata query writer interface, checks if the provided buffer is sufficient, and if so, copies the location into the buffer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the metadata query writer interface

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: Length of the buffer provided to store the location

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer where the location will be stored

parameters.name: ret_len
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable where the function will store the actual length of the location

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, WINCODEC_ERR_INSUFFICIENTBUFFER if the provided buffer is too small, or E_INVALIDARG if the ret_len pointer is NULL.

function.name: map_type
function.description: This function maps a given string to a variable type. It iterates over an array of predefined string-variable type pairs, comparing the input string with each pair. If a match is found, the corresponding variable type is returned. If no match is found, a warning is issued and an illegal variable type is returned.

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the string that needs to be mapped to a variable type.

function.return_type: VARTYPE, which represents the variable type that the input string maps to. If the string does not map to any predefined variable types, VT_ILLEGAL is returned.

function.name: get_type_name
function.description: This function iterates over an array 'str2vt' to find a match for the input 'vt'. If a match is found, it returns the corresponding string. If no match is found, it returns NULL.

parameters.name: vt
parameters.description: This parameter is used to match with the 'vt' member of the 'str2vt' array elements.

function.return_type: WCHAR. It represents the string matched with the input 'vt' in the 'str2vt' array. If no match is found, it returns NULL.

function.name: wincodecs_array_reserve
function.description: This function reserves memory for an array. If the count is greater than the current capacity, it increases the capacity of the array. It also checks if the required memory is available. If not, it returns false. If the memory is successfully allocated, it updates the elements and capacity pointers and returns true.

parameters.name: elements
parameters.description: A pointer to the array elements

parameters.name: capacity
parameters.description: A pointer to the current capacity of the array

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of elements that the array needs to hold

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of each element in the array

function.return_type: bool, returns true if the memory is successfully allocated and false otherwise

function.name: parser_skip_char
function.description: This function checks if the current character in the parser matches the given character. If it doesn't match or if the parser has previously encountered an error, it sets an error code and returns true. If it matches, it advances the parser and returns false.

parameters.name: parser
parameters.description: The parser that is used to parse the query

parameters.name: ch
parameters.description: The character to be skipped in the parser

function.return_type: bool, returns true if the parser has previously encountered an error or if the current character doesn't match the given character, otherwise returns false

function.name: parse_query_index
function.description: This function parses a query index from a given parser and stores the result in a provided unsigned integer pointer. It handles various error conditions and edge cases, such as unsupported index values and invalid query characters.

parameters.name: parser
parameters.description: A pointer to a query_parser structure. This structure contains the query to be parsed.

parameters.name: ret
parameters.description: A pointer to an unsigned integer. The parsed index from the query is stored in this location.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value. It modifies the values of the provided pointers.

function.name: parser_unescape
function.description: This function checks if the first character in the parser's string is a backslash. If it is, it increments the pointer to the next character. If the next character is null, it returns true. Otherwise, it returns false.

parameters.name: parser
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the query_parser structure. The function uses this parameter to access the string that needs to be parsed.

function.return_type: bool, returns true if the first character in the parser's string is a backslash and the next character is null, otherwise returns false.

function.name: parse_query_name
function.description: This function parses a query name from the parser's current position until it encounters a '/' or ':' character. It also handles escape sequences and initializes a PROPVARIANT item with the parsed string.

parameters.name: parser
parameters.description: A pointer to the query parser structure. It contains the current position of the parser and other related data.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: A pointer to a PROPVARIANT structure. This structure will be initialized with the parsed string.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value. It modifies the input parameters instead.

function.name: parse_query_data_item
function.description: This function parses a query data item. It processes the type and value of the item, and handles different types of data accordingly.

parameters.name: parser
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a query_parser structure. It is used to parse the query data item.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a PROPVARIANT structure. It is used to store the parsed data item.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value. It modifies the input parameters directly.

function.name: parse_query_item
function.description: This function checks the state of the parser and depending on the character at the parser's pointer, it either parses query data item or query name.

parameters.name: parser
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the query parser structure.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the PROPVARIANT structure.

function.return_type: void, meaning this function does not return any value

function.name: parse_add_component
function.description: This function adds a component to the parser's components array. If there is not enough memory to add a new component, it sets the parser's hr field to E_OUTOFMEMORY.

parameters.name: parser
parameters.description: A pointer to the query parser structure where the component will be added.

parameters.name: comp
parameters.description: A pointer to the component that will be added to the parser's components array.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value but modifies the parser's components array and potentially its hr field.

function.name: parse_query_component
function.description: This function parses a query component from a given query parser. It handles optional indices, resolves known names, and adds the parsed component to the parser.

parameters.name: parser
parameters.description: A pointer to the query parser that contains the query to be parsed.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value but modifies the input parser.

function.name: parser_set_top_level_metadata_handler
function.description: This function sets the top level metadata handler for a query parser. It checks if the handler is a block handler, validates the root component, gets the count of metadata blocks, and then iterates over them to find the matching handler. If a match is found, it is set as the reader for the component.

parameters.name: query_handler
parameters.description: Pointer to the query handler structure which is used to handle the query.

parameters.name: parser
parameters.description: Pointer to the query parser structure which is used to parse the query.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, WINCODEC_ERR_INVALIDQUERYREQUEST if the root component is not valid, or WINCODEC_ERR_PROPERTYNOTFOUND if the reader is not found.

function.name: parser_resolve_component_handlers
function.description: This function resolves component handlers for a query parser. It sets the top-level metadata handler and iterates through the components of the parser. For each component, it checks if the previous component has a handler, expands schema URLs for known formats, gets the value of the metadata reader, and queries the interface for the handler.

parameters.name: query_handler
parameters.description: A pointer to the query handler structure. It is used to handle the query.

parameters.name: parser
parameters.description: A pointer to the query parser structure. It is used to parse the query.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: parse_query
function.description: This function parses a query, validates it, and prepares it for further processing. It also handles memory allocation and error checking for the query parsing process.

parameters.name: query_handler
parameters.description: Pointer to the query handler structure, which handles the query processing.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Pointer to the query string that needs to be parsed.

parameters.name: parser
parameters.description: Pointer to the query parser structure, which holds the parsed query components and related information.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the function execution. It can indicate success, failure, or specific error codes.

function.name: parser_cleanup
function.description: This function cleans up the parser by releasing the handler, clearing the schema and id of each component, and freeing the memory allocated to the components and scratch.

parameters.name: parser
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the query parser structure that needs to be cleaned up.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.name: query_handler_GetMetadataByName
function.description: This function retrieves metadata by name from a query handler. It parses the query, checks the last component of the query, and based on the handler type, either creates a new query handler or retrieves the value from the metadata reader.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface of a metadata query writer.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Long pointer to a constant wide string representing the query.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Pointer to a PROPVARIANT structure that receives the value of the metadata.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK on success, or an error code on failure.

function.name: query_get_guid_item_string
function.description: This function converts a GUID into a string. If the 'resolve' parameter is true and the GUID can be mapped to a short name, the function returns the short name. Otherwise, it formats the GUID into a string and returns it.

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: A pointer to a string where the result will be stored

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: The length of the 'str' buffer

parameters.name: guid
parameters.description: A pointer to the GUID to be converted into a string

parameters.name: resolve
parameters.description: A flag indicating whether to attempt to map the GUID to a short name

function.return_type: WCHAR*, represents the pointer to the string that contains the GUID or its short name if resolved successfully

function.name: impl_from_IEnumString
function.description: This function returns a pointer to a string_enumerator structure that contains the IEnumString interface passed to it.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer used to access the string_enumerator structure.

function.return_type: struct string_enumerator *; it represents a pointer to a string_enumerator structure.

function.name: string_enumerator_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface identifier (riid) matches the known interfaces (IEnumString or IUnknown). If it does, it assigns the address of the IEnumString interface to the ppv parameter and increases the reference count. If it doesn't, it sets ppv to NULL and returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IEnumString interface

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the interface identifier to be queried

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer that, on successful return, points to the requested interface

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call. Returns S_OK if the interface is supported, and E_NOINTERFACE if it is not

function.name: string_enumerator_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the string enumerator object and returns the new reference count.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the string enumerator interface.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after incrementing.

function.name: string_enumerator_Release
function.description: This function releases the string enumerator and associated resources if the reference count drops to zero.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer to the string enumerator object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the string enumerator object after decrementing.

function.name: string_enumerator_update_guid_index
function.description: This function updates the GUID index of a string enumerator. It queries the interface for a metadata reader, gets the metadata format, checks if the GUID is equal to any of the existing GUIDs in the enumerator, and if not, reserves space for a new GUID and updates the count.

parameters.name: enumerator
parameters.description: The string enumerator to update

parameters.name: guid
parameters.description: The GUID to update the index for

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: The index to be updated

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The object to query the interface from

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the operation was successful, E_OUTOFMEMORY if there was not enough memory to reserve for a new GUID, or the HRESULT from the metadata reader operations

function.name: get_query_item_name
function.description: This function retrieves the name of a query item. It handles different types of variant data and formats the name accordingly.

parameters.name: var
parameters.description: Pointer to a PROPVARIANT structure that contains the variant data for the query item.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Pointer to a wide-character string that receives the name of the query item.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK on success, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if it fails to allocate memory.

function.name: string_enumerator_Next
function.description: This function enumerates strings and returns the next string in the sequence. It also handles memory allocation and error checking.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface for the string enumerator

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of strings to enumerate

parameters.name: strings
parameters.description: Pointer to the array of strings

parameters.name: fetched
parameters.description: Pointer to the variable that receives the number of strings that were fetched

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation was successful, E_INVALIDARG if the strings parameter is NULL, E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, and S_FALSE if the fetched count is less than the requested count.

function.name: string_enumerator_Reset
function.description: This function resets the string enumerator. If the object enumerator exists, it resets it. If the metadata enumerator exists, it resets it. If neither exists, it simply returns S_OK.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer used to access the string enumerator.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful.

function.name: string_enumerator_Skip
function.description: This function skips a specified number of elements in the enumeration sequence. It uses either an object enumerator or a metadata enumerator, depending on which one is available.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the string enumerator

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of elements to skip in the enumeration sequence

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the operation was successful, otherwise an error code

function.name: string_enumerator_Clone
function.description: This function clones a string enumerator, creating a new enumerator that contains the same enumeration state as the current one.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the string enumerator to be cloned.

parameters.name: out
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer that receives the interface pointer to the new enumerator object.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. The function returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_OUTOFMEMORY if there is insufficient memory to complete the operation, or other error codes if the operation fails.

function.name: string_enumerator_init
function.description: This function initializes a string enumerator object. It sets the vtable, reference count, and optionally copies GUIDs. It also sets and adds a reference to the object and metadata enumerators.

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The string enumerator object to initialize.

parameters.name: guids
parameters.description: Optional GUIDs to copy into the object.

parameters.name: object_enumerator
parameters.description: An enumerator for the object.

parameters.name: metadata_enumerator
parameters.description: An enumerator for the metadata.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK on success, and an error code on failure.

function.name: string_enumerator_create
function.description: This function initializes a string enumerator object. It first allocates memory for the object, then checks if the handler is a block handler. Depending on the result, it gets the enumerator from either the block reader or the reader. It then initializes the string enumerator with the obtained enumerator. If the initialization is successful, it sets the output parameter to the IEnumString interface of the object and increases its reference count. Finally, it releases the IEnumString interface of the object and returns the result of the initialization.

parameters.name: handler
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the query handler. It is used to get the enumerator from either the block reader or the reader.

parameters.name: out
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer to an IEnumString. If the initialization is successful, it is set to the IEnumString interface of the object.

function.return_type: HRESULT. It represents the result of the initialization. If the memory allocation fails, it returns E_OUTOFMEMORY. Otherwise, it returns the result of string_enumerator_init.

function.name: query_handler_GetEnumerator
function.description: This function creates a string enumerator for a query handler.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface used to write metadata queries.

parameters.name: enum_string
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an enumeration of strings.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the function. It returns a success code if the string enumerator is created successfully, otherwise it returns an error code.

function.name: query_handler_SetMetadataByName
function.description: This function is a stub, meant to handle setting metadata by name but currently only logs the input parameters and returns a success status.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface for writing metadata queries.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the metadata to be set.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value of the metadata to be set.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Currently, it always returns S_OK indicating a successful operation.

function.name: query_handler_RemoveMetadataByName
function.description: This function removes metadata by its name from a given query writer interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: A pointer to the query writer interface from which the metadata will be removed.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: A pointer to the name of the metadata to be removed.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the function succeeds or an error code if it fails.

function.name: unsafe_impl_from_IWICMetadataQueryReader
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface is NULL or if its vtable doesn't match the expected vtable. If either condition is met, it returns NULL. Otherwise, it returns the containing record of the interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface that is being checked and whose containing record may be returned.

function.return_type: struct query_handler*, which represents the containing record of the interface if the conditions are met, or NULL otherwise.

function.name: create_query_handler
function.description: This function creates a query handler for metadata objects. It initializes the query handler structure, sets its properties, and returns it through the 'ret' parameter.

parameters.name: block_handler
parameters.description: This is a pointer to an unknown block handler object.

parameters.name: object_type
parameters.description: This is the type of the metadata object.

parameters.name: root
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the root of the metadata object.

parameters.name: ret
parameters.description: This is a double pointer to a IWICMetadataQueryWriter object. The function will return the created query handler through this parameter.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the function execution. It returns S_OK if the function executes successfully, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails.

function.name: MetadataQueryReader_CreateInstanceFromBlockReader
function.description: This function creates an instance of a metadata query reader from a block reader.

parameters.name: block_reader
parameters.description: This is the block reader from which the metadata query reader instance is created.

parameters.name: out
parameters.description: This is the output parameter where the created metadata query reader instance is stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: MetadataQueryWriter_CreateInstanceFromBlockWriter
function.description: This function creates an instance of a metadata query writer from a block writer.

parameters.name: block_writer
parameters.description: This is the block writer from which the metadata query writer instance is created.

parameters.name: out
parameters.description: This is the output parameter where the created metadata query writer instance is stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. Otherwise, it returns an error code.

function.name: MetadataQueryReader_CreateInstance
function.description: This function creates an instance of a metadata query reader.

parameters.name: reader
parameters.description: A pointer to an IWICMetadataReader object that will be used to create the query reader instance.

parameters.name: out
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to an IWICMetadataQueryReader object. This will be used to store the created query reader instance.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: MetadataQueryWriter_CreateInstance
function.description: This function creates an instance of a metadata query writer.

parameters.name: writer
parameters.description: A pointer to an IWICMetadataWriter object that is used to write metadata.

parameters.name: out
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to an IWICMetadataQueryWriter object that receives the created instance.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the function. It returns S_OK if successful, or an error value otherwise.

function.name: create_metadata_query_writer_from_reader
function.description: This function creates a metadata query writer from a given metadata query reader. It first checks if the reader object is valid and if it is a block handler, returning appropriate error codes if not. Then it creates a metadata writer from the reader and a query handler from the writer, releasing the writer afterwards.

parameters.name: query_reader
parameters.description: Pointer to the metadata query reader from which the writer is to be created

parameters.name: vendor
parameters.description: Pointer to the vendor GUID

parameters.name: query_writer
parameters.description: Pointer to the pointer of the metadata query writer to be created

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It can be a success code, or an error code if the operation failed

function.name: WICMapGuidToShortName
function.description: This function maps a GUID to a short name. It checks if the GUID is equal to any of the GUIDs in the guid2name array. If a match is found, it copies the corresponding short name into the 'name' parameter and returns S_OK. If no match is found, it returns WINCODEC_ERR_PROPERTYNOTFOUND.

parameters.name: guid
parameters.description: The GUID to be mapped to a short name.

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: The length of the 'name' buffer.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: A pointer to the buffer that receives the short name.

parameters.name: ret_len
parameters.description: A pointer to a variable that receives the length of the short name, including the null terminator.

function.return_type: HRESULT. It returns S_OK if the function succeeds, E_INVALIDARG if an argument is invalid, HRESULT_FROM_WIN32(ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER) if the 'name' buffer is too small, and WINCODEC_ERR_PROPERTYNOTFOUND if the GUID is not found.

function.name: WICMapShortNameToGuid
function.description: This function maps a short name to a GUID. If the name is found in the guid2name array, the corresponding GUID is assigned to the guid parameter. If the name is not found, an error is returned.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: This is the short name to be mapped to a GUID.

parameters.name: guid
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a GUID variable where the result will be stored if the name is found.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If the name or guid parameters are null, it returns E_INVALIDARG. If the name is not found in the guid2name array, it returns WINCODEC_ERR_PROPERTYNOTFOUND.

function.name: map_shortname_to_schema
function.description: This function maps a short name to a schema. It checks if the provided format matches with either GUID_MetadataFormatXMP or GUID_MetadataFormatXMPStruct. If it does, it then iterates over the name2schema array to find a match for the provided name. If a match is found, it returns the corresponding schema. If no match is found or if the format does not match, it returns NULL.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: This parameter is used to specify the format of the metadata. It is checked against GUID_MetadataFormatXMP and GUID_MetadataFormatXMPStruct.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: This parameter is the name that needs to be mapped to a schema. It is compared with the names in the name2schema array.

function.return_type: WCHAR. This represents the schema corresponding to the provided name. If no match is found or if the format does not match, it returns NULL.

function.name: WICMapSchemaToName
function.description: This function maps a schema to a name. It supports only xmp and xmpstruct metadata formats. It checks for valid arguments, and if the schema is found in the name2schema array, it copies the corresponding name into the provided buffer, and returns the length of the name.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The format of the metadata. Only xmp and xmpstruct are supported.

parameters.name: schema
parameters.description: The schema to be mapped to a name.

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: The length of the buffer provided for the name.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The buffer where the name will be copied.

parameters.name: ret_len
parameters.description: A pointer to a variable where the function will store the length of the name.

function.return_type: HRESULT. It returns S_OK if the function succeeds, E_INVALIDARG if any of the arguments are invalid, WINCODEC_ERR_PROPERTYNOTFOUND if the format is not supported or the schema is not found, and HRESULT_FROM_WIN32(ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER) if the buffer provided for the name is not large enough.
